title: Missing "drag" cursor image in Windows
body:
### Tested versions

- tested in 4.5.1

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22621) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8132) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12500H (16 threads) - 15.69 GiB memory

### Issue description

When customizing a Button node for a grabbable component, I was looking for a cursor shape akin to the 'grab' shape from css spec. A semi-closed hand that closes further when you hold click.
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/cursor

No such shape is on the list. Then I noticed CursorShape.CURSOR_DRAG, in my machine, is the same as the default CursorShape.CURSOR_MOVE, four arrows, instead of the closed hand as described in the documentation. 
I also found shape CursorShape.CURSOR_CAN_DROP is the default Arrow shape, although I don't see an open palm shape in the CSS spec.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a Button node
- Inspector, change Mouse > Default Cursor Shape.
- Test run, hover over the button to check.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[cursorshapes.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23756123/cursorshapes.zip)
there are four buttons, Arrow, Can Drop, Drag and Move. In my machine, arrow and candrop are the same default arrow, and drag and move are the same 4-arrow cross.
